User Story: As an operator I see the lockup arrive before commands so I know who I am talking to.
Expected Behaviour: Boot steps 0-6 over ~4s. Step 1 lockup only. Step 2 blink. Step 3 name and tag. Step 4+ command list. Step 6 prompt. prefers-reduced-motion jumps to step 6.
Edge Cases: Reduced motion; unmount mid-boot; click before ready is ignored.

User Story: As an operator I always see the 5x3 ninja head as the single character.
Expected Behaviour: Renders FRAMES[state] three lines. Quiet hides label. Color from tone map.
Edge Cases: Unknown state would throw. Only one instance on screen.

User Story: As an operator I see him blink every 6-14s while idle and online.
Expected Behaviour: 150ms ── then ●●. No blink when offline or not ready.
Edge Cases: Offline after ready must stop blink. Reduced motion still blinks after ready.

User Story: As an operator I start work from visible commands.
Expected Behaviour: Buttons now todo pause plan api pgeon call run(cmd).
Edge Cases: Clicks during boot ignored. Stop propagation vs page focus.

User Story: As an operator I type a command and submit with Enter.
Expected Behaviour: Trims input. Empty submit no-ops. Logs cmd then reply after 650ms. Clears field.
Edge Cases: Whitespace only. Slash prefix stripped. Auto focus after boot.

User Story: As an operator I ask now and see live version pause and saved work.
Expected Behaviour: now overview what whats return Current state fields Live Next Saved Feature pause.
Edge Cases: Empty string cardFor returns today not now. START now must match this card.
Notes: now currently aliased to today in cardFor

User Story: As an operator I ask todo and see the four jobs that need me.
Expected Behaviour: todo tasks loops return four loop titles. today and do return numbered list with select-a-line copy.
Edge Cases: Rows promised clickable.

User Story: As an operator I ask pause and learn why new work is held.
Expected Behaviour: pause and freeze are unknown. No countdown in the hero.
Edge Cases: Old freeze alias is gone.

User Story: As an operator I ask plan and see jobs laid out by dependency.
Expected Behaviour: plan gantt blockers chart return five scheduled bars. Mint ready. Accent critical path. Gray waiting. Click bar inspects job.
Edge Cases: Horizon 4. Cycle deps guarded. Short gantt aliases.

User Story: As an operator I ask api and see what the main program does.
Expected Behaviour: api or look api returns The brain job and next step.
Edge Cases: Unknown service falls through. workbench shortcut.

User Story: As an operator I type help and see every command I can run.
Expected Behaviour: help hi hello words list now todo pause plan offline api pgeon.
Edge Cases: Missing wake reconnect status clear.

User Story: As an operator I put him to sleep or lose the network and see the offline face.
Expected Behaviour: offline or sleep sets offline. Eyes ‒‒ muted. No blink. Other commands refused. navigator.onLine false also sets it.
Edge Cases: wake while actually offline stays offline. reconnect promised.

User Story: As an operator I type wake and he returns if the network is up.
Expected Behaviour: wake or online clears simulated offline unless navigator is offline.
Edge Cases: reconnect documented but not accepted.

User Story: As an operator I type clear and the transcript empties.
Expected Behaviour: clear sets lines to [] mood idle. No card printed.
Edge Cases: Clear while offline is blocked by offline gate.

User Story: As an operator I type garbage and he errors.
Expected Behaviour: Unknown command card. Face should be error ×× then idle.
Edge Cases: afterCommand still looks for old titles.

User Story: As an operator I click a chart bar or name a job and read why it exists.
Expected Behaviour: findBlocker by id or title. Shows days start ready or waits on.
Edge Cases: Short queries match too many titles.

User Story: As an operator I name a loop and read why it matters.
Expected Behaviour: No loop table exists in the current shell. cardFor does not implement findLoop.
Edge Cases: Ghost from an earlier cut.

User Story: As an operator I name a part of the machine and read its job.
Expected Behaviour: look X or service id or label. First service if look with no match.
Edge Cases: the matches The brain. Retired kanban included.

User Story: As an operator I see evaluating then a result face.
Expected Behaviour: 650ms evaluating ◐◑ then afterCommand then 800/1200ms hold then idle.
Edge Cases: Unknown should error. pause should warning.

User Story: As an operator I see ?? while I type.
Expected Behaviour: Input non-empty and idle mood shows asking.
Edge Cases: Offline overrides asking.

User Story: As an operator who prefers less motion I skip the boot wait.
Expected Behaviour: matchMedia reduce sets boot 6 immediately. CSS animations disabled.

User Story: As an operator I see Hubzz dark surfaces and purple accent.
Expected Behaviour: body bg #0E0F12 fg #c7d2da mono IBM Plex. accent #735FFA.
Edge Cases: Missing @theme breaks all utilities.

User Story: As an operator I open / and get the terminal.
Expected Behaviour: Route / renders Mininja. Title Mininja.

User Story: As an operator I can open /login.
Expected Behaviour: Shows Sign in. If auth disabled shows Sign-in is disabled.
Edge Cases: Auth typically off.

User Story: As an operator I see a recovery screen if a route throws.
Expected Behaviour: AppErrorComponent with message and alert icon.
Edge Cases: Uses zinc light/dark not Hubzz tokens.

User Story: As an operator sharing a link I get a titled page and theme color.
Expected Behaviour: utf-8 viewport title Mininja theme-color #0E0F12 og type x:game favicon manifest.
Edge Cases: og image only if VITE_PUBLIC_HOSTNAME set.

User Story: As an operator I click the page and the prompt focuses.
Expected Behaviour: Root click focuses command input. Command buttons stopPropagation.

User Story: As an operator on a phone I use the same terminal without horizontal scroll.
Expected Behaviour: 390px no overflow-x. Gantt stacks. Prompt usable.
Edge Cases: Day headers hidden under sm.

User Story: As an operator the chart orders work by what must finish first.
Expected Behaviour: earliest start = max(dep.end). Critical = on a longest path to max end. Cycles return 0.
Edge Cases: Empty list horizon 1. Missing dep skipped.

User Story: As an operator I expect loading allowed denied sandbox cancelled faces when those events happen.
Expected Behaviour: Frames exist in FRAMES. pgeon best/vote/ask empty now trigger allowed sandbox denied.
Edge Cases: Spec incomplete vs live moods.

User Story: As an operator I type status and see what is up.
Expected Behaviour: cardFor has no status verb. afterCommand still mentions it. Result is Unknown command.
Edge Cases: Stale register row.
Notes: Do not implement a fake status box

User Story: As an operator I can install the page.
Expected Behaviour: Public tree ships favicon/og only; Grok PWA install chrome not included.
Edge Cases: Grok template install page deferred / not shipped.
Notes: Not product-specific; stripped from public monorepo

User Story: As an operator I run pgeon and see verified answers where votes cannot mint a best.
Expected Behaviour: pgeon is a modular plugin. open lists questions. best returns carol and gates bob. vote bob records votes and leaves best on carol. ask empty returns no best. Faces allowed sandbox denied.
Edge Cases: Unknown verb errors. reset restores seed. Store is session-only.
Notes: Converted arena core only no HTTP MCP or BT

User Story: As an operator I turn prompt refinement on or off with one command.
Expected Behaviour: refine with no argument toggles. refine on and refine off set the switch. Hero shows refine while on. Off removes it. Fitness is still not a verified best.
Edge Cases: Unknown verbs error. reset turns it off.

User Story: As an operator I see a small ASCII pigeon join him when pgeon is active.
Expected Behaviour: Pigeon is a 2-line (•)> /) mark in the hero. Pose follows the last pgeon card. Leaves when the last card has no bird.
Edge Cases: Reduced motion holds frame 0.
Notes: Guest in hero not in the pile

User Story: As an operator I run the sidecar loop without growing another program.
Expected Behaviour: compound prints the sidecar. goal shows locked criteria. skeleton lists modules. sequence is light. check locks compound. next stops at 5/5.
Edge Cases: reset restores seed. Default verb is sidecar not help.

User Story: As an operator I run qa and read the feature register.
Expected Behaviour: qa prints coverage. discover lists every Feature ID as a pickable qa Fnn line. tests lists suites. run shows last counts. defects lists D ids. Fnn inspects one row.
Edge Cases: JSON must be regenerated from qa/*.csv after register edits.
Notes: Callable playbook not a second spreadsheet

User Story: As an operator I run one fitness pick only when refine is on.
Expected Behaviour: turn while refine is off is denied. turn while on ranks the frozen candidates. lead is gate at 0.91. warning face. Does not write the pgeon ledger.
Edge Cases: Bare name is the pick. Extra verbs ignored.
Notes: New module. Refine stays a switch
